name: AfterParty
source:
It's time for a break from work and to celebrate that you, Laine, are the host of a party!

But something went wrong, and now you are dead and have to survive against the onslaught of various foes...

[From [url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/afterparty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是时候放下工作休息一下了，庆祝你，莱恩，成为了一场派对的主持人！

但出了点问题，现在你死了，必须在各种敌人的攻击下生存……

[来自[url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/afterparty]Itch.io[/url]]
